channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Emergency 24/7
channel.desc: A catastrophic dual carriageway collision brings two patients to Southmead Emergency Department: Tom, the driver who caused the crash, and Olli, the man whose van he hit. Tom, who is believed to have been driving under the influence of drugs and on the wrong side of the carriageway, arrives with devastating injuries to his leg. Meanwhile, a young girl is brought to Resus after falling from her horse, unable to move or feel her legs.
